content.title: Play online today at DCiLottery.com
content.text: Play the Lottery Online Experience the thrill of winning the Lottery right now, wherever you are in the District. New ways to play to your own rhythm! Fun is at your fingertips with DC iLottery. You can play DC-3, DC-4, DC-5, Lucky for Life, Powerball, Mega Millions, and our NEW e-Instant games from almost anywhere in the District using a smartphone, computer, or tablet. FREE play bonus when you register Once you register for a DC iLottery account, we will 100% match your first deposit with up to $250 in Bonus Money! Join the fun. Make an account today to play DC Lottery online! It's quick, easy, and FREE to register for a DC iLottery account. Simply complete the required fields on both pages of the registration form, and you’ll be on your way to earning exclusive benefits, including a free e-Instant play and bonus match on your first deposit. 1 Register Go to DCiLottery.com Click Register and enter your info ... 2 Deposit Funds Select Deposit and add a payment method ... 3 Play! That's it! You're ready to go! Register for FREE and Play Today! *We accept PayPal, credit, debit, Skrill and bank account ACH. The minimum deposit is $10. What is iLottery? We’re so glad you asked! iLottery is simply the DC Lottery — online! Register for an iLottery account and you can play Powerball, Mega Millions and e-Instant games any phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop computer that has an up-to-date web browser and internet connectivity. iLottery is available 24/7 and you can play anywhere, anytime, in the District of Columbia. Prize money goes directly into your iLottery account and held until you decide what to do with it: Play more games, make a withdrawal through the iLottery portal, or receive a prize check at DC Lottery Prize Center. What games can I play online with iLottery? Lots of People Win with DC Lottery—even online. With iLottery, you can play DC-3, DC-4, DC-5, Powerball, Mega Millions and Lucky for Life from your computer, smartphone or other device. You can play any of our fun e-Instant games online, too! Who can play iLottery? You must be 18 years or older, have an account with sufficient funds and be physically located within The District of Columbia boundaries to play iLottery. The Lottery may take necessary action against an underage player who circumvents or attempts to circumvent controls to prevent underage play. Actions may include, but are not limited to, immediate stoppage of play, account closure, and confiscation of winnings. Do I have to be in Washington, D.C. to play iLottery? Yes and NO. The platforms have a geo-fencing feature that requires iLottery players to be within Washington, D.C. and not within restricted play areas of the District. However, you can login and access your iLottery Account from anywhere. This includes depositing and withdrawing funds to/from your account. What is the difference between a Quick Pick and a Quick Play? We are so glad you asked! A Quick Pick is a number selection option for players where the computer generates the numbers. A Quick Play is a complete play, same play type as your previous selection, with a new set of numbers already generated by the computer. To register for an account, you must be 18 years of age or older and pass an identity verification process, which requires the submission of the last four digits of their Social Security Number. Need help? Our Customer Care team is here to help 24/7. Call at 1-833-515-0574 or email us at support@dcilottery.com.
